Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive (ML/infra) - Acme Health Tech

Hi Sarah / Carlos,

Thanks again for the time today

really helpful to understand Acme's inference goals and current constraints. Quick recap and suggested next steps:

- Goal: Run clinical NLP models in production with 250-400 concurrent sessions, average seq length ~1024, and P95 latency target of ~900ms for token generation.
- Current infra: Kubernetes GPU-backed inference with custom batching; primary blocker is cost and reliability during peak ingest.
- Key stakeholders for the deep dive: Dr. Ravi Shah (ML Lead), Emily Tran (Infra Lead), and platform engineers.

Next step: Technical deep dive (60-90 minutes) with your ML + infra team so we can:
1) Walk through Acme's model graph, batching patterns, and KV cache needs
2) Align on network/security constraints (VPC, KMS, data residency)
3) Review proposed serving topology and expected TP/latency tradeoffs
4) Identify a test plan and pilot success metrics

Proposed time slots (all in PT):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00-11:30
- Tue Mar 23, 14:00-15:30
- Wed Mar 24, 09:00-10:30

I've attached a short requirements summary and our trial proposal for background. Could you confirm preferred slot and who from your side will join? If those times don't work, send a couple alternatives and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks - looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
